name: Caleb
source:
Caleb is Amaia's childhood friend, a captain of the guard with a heart of gold, who has secret feelings for his princess... but alas, her hand is taken. 

[From [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/the-dragon-princess]Itch.io[/url]]
